description:
Job Title: Oracle PL/SQL Developer 
 Location: Washington, DC 
 Duration: 6+Months 
 
 MUST GO FOR FACE TO FACE AFTER PHONE SCREENING 
 
 Here is the requirement: 
 Provide network infrastructure support and back-end support for all NetWare and Microsoft systems hardware and operating systems, LAN/WAN connectivity and other service delivery functions. 
 Assist in application testing, installations, configuration and integration to meet requirements. 
 · Support .NET applications and underlying development, test, and production system environments. 
 · Implement and maintain utilities and application interfaces to support ongoing and new functionalities. 
 · Support the user community by troubleshooting and resolving database environment issues, resolving software performance issues, and serving as a technical liaison to the development team. 
 · Perform minor UNIX systems administration functions by supporting Linux and UNIX servers, including HP-UNIX services running production, development and test Oracle database environments. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 · Minimum 8 years of experience as an Oracle Database Administrator/Engineer 
 · Knowledge and understanding of TCP/IP networking 
 · Oracle PL/SQL programming skills and Crystal Reports XI/2013 development experience including but not limited to: 
 · Stored procedures and views 
 · Performance tuning of queries 
 · Ability to deliver in a dynamic environment 
 · Good analytical skills 
 · Ability to understand diverse requirements from multiple stakeholder groups 
 · Good technical documentation skills. 
 · Working knowledge of cloud-based Business Intelligence systems 
 · Expertise in Oracle 11g Database 
 · Expertise in PL/SQL 
 · Expertise in Crystal Reports XI (and earlier versions) 
 · Proficiency in Business Objects 
 · Proficiency in Quality Assurance methodologies and tools 
 · Basic knowledge of Microsoft Visual Studio, ASP.NET , C# 
 · Experience with Business Objects platform, Microsoft.NET , ASP.NET , C#, VB.Net , Visual Studio Team Foundation Developer's Suite, and Crystal Reports XI server administration experience 
 · Ability to communicate with business and program staff; to take direction and feedback; to meet tight deadlines and work both independently and within a team when necessary; willingness to take initiative and ownership of tasks. 
 · Knowledge of basic project management methodologies and tools 
 
 Desired Skills 
 · Experience in Federal, State and/or local government IT operations 
 



 If you are interested in above position, please share your updated resume to gmahesh(at)usmsystems(dot)com or can directly call me on 703-880-4184.
